name: hospital-app
description: Runs the client and server together with one command. `npm run dev` for local development (2 dev servers, hot reload). `npm start` for a single all-in-one process (builds the frontend, then one Node server serves everything - used for deployment).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
